Movie Watchlist

Keep a movie watchlist with personal ratings and a watched toggle.

—
Average rating
0
Movies

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the movie title, optional year, and your 1–5 star rating.
  2. Click Add Movie.
  3. Toggle Watched on a card when you've seen it.
  4. Filter by All / To Watch / Watched to browse.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add and rate a movie?

Add the movie title and year, then rate it 1–5 stars. The star buttons set your personal rating.

How do I mark a movie as watched?

Click the Watched toggle on the card. Watched movies move to the Watched section.

Does it show my average rating?

Yes — the average of all your rated movies is shown at the top.

Where is my watchlist stored?

In this browser's localStorage, private to this device.
